spans.s: जप् vt. 1P (pp. जपित; pres. जपति) 1. To utter in a low voice, to mutter, हरिरिति हरिरिति जपति सकामम् Git.G.iv.; 2. to mutter (prayers or incantations), M.xi.194.With उप-, to whisper into the ears, to bring over to one’s party by secretly suggesting anything in the ear, to rouse to rebellion, उपजप्यानुजपेत् M.vii.197.
जप m. 1. Repeating prayers in a murmuring tone; 2. repeating passages of the Veda, M.iii.74; 3. a muttered prayer.
जपा f. The China rose (either the plant or its flower), सांध्यं तेजः प्रतिनवजपापुष्परक्तं दधानः Megh.i.36.
जाप m. 1. Muttering prayers; 2. a muttered prayer.
जप-परायण a. engaged in muttering prayers.
